verses.sanskrit:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच।
              सुदुष्करमिदं कर्म कृतं भीमेन सञ्जय । येन कर्णो महाबाहू रथोपस्थे निपातितः ॥१॥
verses.english: Dhritarashtra said Highly difficult was this feat performed by Bhima, O Sanjaya, by which the mighty-armed Karna was caused to lie down on his car.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णो ह्येको रणे हन्ता पाण्डवान्सृञ्जयैः सह । इति दुर्योधनः सूत प्राब्रवीन्मां मुहुर्मुहुः ॥२॥
verses.english: “There is Karna who alone will kill the Pandava along with Srinjayas.” This my son Duryodhana oftentimes said to me.

verses.sanskrit: पराजितं तु राधेयं दृष्ट्वा भीमेन संयुगे । ततः परं किमकरोत्पुत्रो दुर्योधनो मम ॥३॥
verses.english: Beholding the son of Radha vanquished by Bhimasena in battle what did my son Duryodhana do afterwards?

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              विमुखं प्रेक्ष्य राधेयं सूतपुत्रं महाहवे । पुत्रस्तव महाराज सोदर्यान्समभाषत ॥४॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Seeing Karna's retreat in that great battle, your son, O king, said to his own brothers.

verses.sanskrit: शीघ्रं गच्छत भद्रं वो राधेयं परिरक्षत । भीमसेनभयागाधे मज्जन्तं व्यसनार्णवे ॥५॥
verses.english: May good betide you! Go quickly and rescue the son of Radha who is plunged into the fathomless calamity consequent upon the fear of Bhimasena.

verses.sanskrit: ते तु राज्ञा समादिष्टा भीमसेनं जिघांसवः । अभ्यवर्तन्त संक्रुद्धाः पतङ्गाः पावकं यथा ॥६॥
verses.english: Thus commanded by the king those princes, worked up with anger and desirous of killing Bhimasena, proceeded towards him like a swarm of insects, towards a blazing fire.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतर्वा दुर्धरः क्राथो विवित्सुर्विकटः समः । निषङ्गी कवची पाशी तथा नन्दोपनन्द‌कौ ॥७॥
verses.english: They were Srutarvan, Durddhara Kratha, Vivitsu, Vikata, Soma, Nishangin, Kavachin, Pashin, Nava, Upanedaka Duspradharsha, Savahu, Vatavega, Suvarchas, Dhanurgraha, Durmada, Jalasandha, Shala and Saha. Encircled by large car-force, those highly energetic and powerful princes approached Bhimasena and surrounded him on all sides.

verses.sanskrit: दुष्प्रधर्षः सुबाहुश्च वातवेगसुवर्चसौ । धनुर्ग्राहो दुर्मदश्च जलसन्धः शलः सहः ॥८॥
एते रथैः परिवृता वीर्यवन्तो महाबलाः । भीमसेनं समासाद्य समन्तात्पर्यवारयन् ॥९॥
ते व्यमुञ्चच्छरव्रातान्नानालिंगान्समन्ततः । स तैरभ्यर्द्यमानस्तु भीमसेनो महाबलः ॥१०॥
verses.english: They discharged at himn from all sides showers of arrows of various sorts. Thus assailed by them, O king, the highly powerful Bhima soon killed fifty leading car-warriors and five hundred from amongst your sons who fell upon him.

verses.sanskrit: तेषामापततां क्षिप्रं सुतानां ते जनाधिप । रथैः पञ्चदशैः सार्धं पञ्चाशदहनद्रथान् ॥११॥
विवित्सोस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो भल्लेनापाहरच्छिरः। भीमसेनो महाराज तत् पपात हतं भुवि ॥१२॥
verses.english: Worked up with anger, Bhima, O king, with a Bhalla, cut-off the head of Vivitsu, adorned with ear-rings and a crown and a face resembling the full-moon. Thus cut-off the prince fell down on earth.

verses.sanskrit: सकुण्डलशिरस्त्राणं पूर्णचन्द्रोपमं तथा । तं दृष्ट्वा निहतं शूरं भ्रातरः सर्वतः प्रभो ॥१३॥
अभ्यद्रवन्त समरे भीमं भीमपराक्रमम् । ततोऽपराभ्यां भल्लाभ्यां पुत्रयोस्ते महाहवे ॥१४॥
verses.english: Beholding their heroic brother slain your other sons, from all sides, rushed upon the terribly powerful Bhima.

verses.sanskrit: जहार समरे प्राणान् भीमो भीमपराक्रमः । तौ धरामन्वपद्येतां वातरुग्णाविव द्रुमौ ॥१५॥
verses.english: With two Bhallas Bhima killed two other sons of yours in that great battle.

verses.sanskrit: विकटश्च सहश्चोभौ देवपुत्रोपमौ नृप । ततस्तु त्वरितो भीमः क्राथं निन्ये यमक्षयम् ॥१६॥
verses.english: Then Vikata and Saha, looking like two celestial youths, fell down on earth like a couple of trees uprooted by a tempest.

verses.sanskrit: नाराचेन सुतीक्ष्णेन स हतो न्यपतद्भुवि । हाहाकारस्ततस्तीव्रः संबभूव जनेश्वर ॥१७॥
verses.english: Then in a moment Bhima dispatched Kratha to the abode of Yama with a long keen arrow. Deprived of life that prince fell down on earth.

verses.sanskrit: वध्यमानेषु वीरेषु तव पुत्रेषु धन्विषु । तेषां सुलुलिते सैन्ये पुनर्भीमो महाबलः ॥१८॥
verses.english: O king, when those your heroic sons, great bowmen, were being thus killed people began to send loud cried of lamentations.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दोपनन्दौ समरे प्रैषयद्यमसादनम् । ततस्ते प्राद्रवन् भीताः पुत्रास्ते विह्वलीकृताः ॥१९॥
verses.english: When your army was once more agitated Bhima sent Nanda and Upananda in that great battle to the abode of the Regent of death.

verses.sanskrit: भीमसेनं रणे दृष्ट्वा कालान्तकयमोपमम् । पुत्रांस्ते निहतान्दृष्ट्वा सूतपुत्रः सुदुर्मनाः ॥२०॥
verses.english: Seeing those sons of yours thus slain Karna once more urged on his swan-like horses to where that son of Pandu was.

verses.sanskrit: हंसवर्णान् हयान्भूयः प्रैषयद्यत्र पाण्डवः । ते प्रेषिता महाराज मद्रराजेन वाजिनः ॥२१॥
verses.english: The horses, driven by the king of Madras, approached quickly the car of Bhimasena and entered into battle.

verses.sanskrit: भीमसेनरथं प्राप्य समसज्जन्त वेगिताः । स सन्निपातस्तुमुलो घोररूपो विशांपते ॥२२॥
आसीद्रौद्रो महाराज कर्णपाण्डवयोर्मृधे । दृष्ट्वा मम महाराज तौ समेतौ महारथौ ॥२३॥
verses.english: Seeing, O king, those two powerful carwarriors near each other I became curious to observe the course of fight.

verses.sanskrit: आसीद्बुद्धिः कथं युद्धमेतदद्य भविष्यति । ततो भीमो रणश्लाघी छाद‌यामास पत्रिभिः ॥२४॥
कर्णं रणे महाराज पुत्राणां तव पश्यताम् । ततः कर्णो भृशं क्रुद्धो भीमं नवभिरायसैः ॥२५॥
verses.english: Then boasting of his power in battle, O king, Bhima covered Karna with Naracha in the presence of your sons.

verses.sanskrit: विव्याध परमास्त्रज्ञो भल्लैः सन्नतपर्वभिः । आहतः स महाबाहुर्भीमो भीमपराक्रमः ॥२६॥
verses.english: Then Karna, a master of best weapons, worked up with anger, struck Karna with nine Bhallas purely made of iron.

verses.sanskrit: आकर्णपूर्णैर्विशिखैः कर्णं विव्याध सप्तभिः । ततः कर्णो महाराज आशीविष इव श्वसन् ॥२७॥
verses.english: Thus struck by Karna the highly powerful and mighty-armed Bhima struck his antagonist in return with seven arrows shot off his bowstring drawn to his ear.

verses.sanskrit: शरवर्षेण महता छादयामास पाण्डवम् । भीमोऽपि तं शरव्रातैश्छादयित्वा महारथम् ॥२८॥
verses.english: Then sighing like a serpent of deadly venom, O king, Karna covered the son of Pandu with a thick shower of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: पश्यतां कौरवेयाणां विननर्द महाबलः । ततः कर्णो भृशं क्रुद्धो दृढमादाय कार्मुकम् ॥२९॥
verses.english: Then covering the mighty car-warrior Karna with a shower of arrows in return before the very eyes of the Kauravas, Bhima sent up a loud war-cry.

verses.sanskrit: भीमं विव्याध दशभिः कङ्कपत्रैः शिलाशितैः । कार्मुकं चास्य चिच्छेद भल्लेन निशितेन च ॥३०॥
ततो भीमो महाबाहुर्हेमपट्टविभूषितम् । परिघं घोरमादाय मृत्युदण्डमिवापरम् ॥३१॥
verses.english: Then taking up a dreadful Parigha adorned with gold resembling the rod of death the mighty-armed Bhima, with a view to kill Karna, hurled it at him making a great roar.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णस्य निधनाकांक्षी चिक्षेपातिबलो नदन् । तमापतन्तं परिघं वज्राशनिसमस्वनम् ॥३२॥
चिच्छेद बहुधा कर्णः शरैराशीविषोपमैः । ततः कार्मुकमादाय भीमो दृढतरं तदा ॥३३॥
verses.english: Then the serpentine arrow Karna sundered into pieces Parigha that was about to fall making a sound like that of a thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit: छादयामास विशिखैः कर्णं परबलार्दनम् । ततो युद्धमभूद्धोरं कर्णपाण्डवयोर्मृधे ॥३४॥
verses.english: Then taking up a bow with grim grasp Bhima, the grinder of enemies, covered Karna with arrows.

verses.sanskrit: हरीन्द्रयोरिव मुहुः परस्परवधैषिणोः । ततः कर्णो महाराज भीमसेनं त्रिभिः शरैः ॥३५॥
verses.english: Then there took place a dreadful encounter between Karna and Bhima desirous of discomfiting each other every moment like that between Hari and Indra.

verses.sanskrit: आकर्णमूलं विव्याध दृढमायम्य कार्मुकम् । सोऽतिविद्धो महेष्वासः कर्णेन बलिनां वरः ॥३६॥
verses.english: Thereupon, O king, drawing firmly to his ear the bow Karna struck Bhima with three arrows.

verses.sanskrit: घोरमादत्त विशिखं कर्णकायावदारणम् । तस्य भित्त्वा तनुत्राणं भित्त्वा कायं च सायकैः ॥३७॥
verses.english: Then pierced by Karna the great bowman, the foremost of the strong, took up a dreadful arrow capable of piercing Karna's body.

verses.sanskrit: प्राविशद्धरणीं राजन्वल्मीकमिव पन्नगः । स तेनातिप्रहारेण व्यथितो विह्वलन्निव ॥३८॥
संचचाल रथे कर्णः क्षितिकम्पे यथाऽचलः । ततः कर्णो महाराज रोषामर्षसमन्वितः ॥३९॥
verses.english: Then with that heavy stroke Karna trembled on his car, as if bewildered like a mountain at the time of earth-quake.

verses.sanskrit: पाण्डवं पञ्चविंशत्या नाराचानां समार्पयत् । आजघ्ने बहुभिर्बाणैर्ध्वजमेकेषुणाऽहनत् ॥४०॥
verses.english: Thereupon O great king, filled with anger and revenge Karna discharged twenty-five Narachas at Bhima. With one arrow he then cut-off Bhima's standard.

verses.sanskrit: सारथिं चास्य भल्लेन प्रेषयामास मृत्यवे । छित्त्वा च कार्मुकं तूर्णं पाण्डवस्याशु पत्रिणा ॥४१॥
verses.english: With another Bhalla he dispatched Bhima's driver to the abode of Yama. Then quickly cutting off his bow with another winged arrow Karna deprived Bhima of dreadful feats of his car.

verses.sanskrit: ततो मुहूर्ताद्राजेन्द्र नातिकृच्छ्राद्धसन्निव । विरथं भीमकर्माणं भीमं कर्णश्चकार ह ॥४२॥
विरथो भरतश्रेष्ठ प्रहसन्ननिलोपमः । गदां गृह्य महाबाहुरपतत्स्यन्दनोत्तमात् ॥४३॥
verses.english: O best of Bharatas, deprived of his car the mighty-armed Bhima, who resembled the Wind-god, took up a mace and jumped down from his excellent car.

verses.sanskrit: अवप्लुत्य च वेगेन तव सैन्यं विशांपते । व्यधमद्गदया भीमः शरन्मेघानिवानिलः ॥४४॥
verses.english: Jumping down furiously from his car Bhima began to kill your troops, O king, like the wind destroying the autumnal clouds.

verses.sanskrit: नागान्सप्तशतान्राजन्नीषादन्तान्प्रहारिणः । व्यधमत्सहसा भीमः क्रुद्धरूपः परंतपः ॥४५॥
verses.english: Suddenly the son ot Pandu, the consumer of enemies worked up with anger, dispersed seven hundred elephants with tusks as large as plough-shares and all skilled in smiting hostile soldiers.

verses.sanskrit: दन्तवेष्टेषु नेत्रेषु कुम्भेषु च कटेषु च । मर्मस्वपि च मर्मज्ञस्तान्नागानवधीद्बली ॥४६॥
verses.english: The powerful hero, conversant with vital parts, killed all those elephants striking them on their temples, frontal globes eyes and in parts above the gums.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते प्राद्रवन्भीताः प्रतीपं प्रहिताः पुनः । महामात्रैस्तमावव्रुर्मेधा इव दिवाकरम् ॥४७॥
verses.english: Then filled with fear those animals ran away. But again urged on by their drivers they surrounded Bhimasena like the clouds covering the sun.

verses.sanskrit: तान् स सप्तशतान्नागान् सारोहायुधकेतनान् । भूमिष्ठो ग‌दया जघ्ने वज्रेणेन्द्र इवाचलान् ॥४८॥
verses.english: Like Indra, striking down mountains with his thunderbolt Bhima, with his mace, struck down those seven hundred elephants with their riders, weapons and standards.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुबलपुत्रस्य नागानतिबलान्पुनः । पोथयामास कौन्तेयो द्विपञ्चाशदरिंदमः ॥४९॥
verses.english: Then the son of Kunti, the subduer of foes, struck down fiftytwo highly powerful elephants belonging to the son of Subala.

verses.sanskrit: तथा रथशतं साग्रं पत्तींश्च शतशोऽपरान् । न्यहनत्पाण्डवो युद्धे तापयंस्तव वाहिनीम् ॥५०॥
verses.english: Then scorching your army the Pandava killed, in battle, a hundred of cars and hundreds of powerful foot soldiers.

verses.sanskrit: प्रताप्यमानं सूर्येण भीमेन च महात्मना । तव सैन्यं संचुकोच चर्माग्नावाहितं यथा ॥५१॥
verses.english: Scorched by the sun and the high-souled Bhima your army began to shrink like a piece of leather spread over a fire.

verses.sanskrit: ते भीमभयसंत्रस्तास्तावका भरतर्षभ । विहाय समरे भीमं दुद्रुवुर्वै दिशो दिश ॥५२॥
verses.english: O foremost of Bharatas, filled with anxiety consequent upon the fear of Bhima, your troops avoided him and fled away in all directions.

verses.sanskrit: रथाः पञ्चशताश्चान्ये ह्रादिनश्चर्मवर्मिणः । भीममभ्यद्रवन् घ्नन्तः शरपूगैः समन्ततः ॥५३॥
verses.english: Then five hundred car-warriors, clad in excellent coats of mail, fell upon Bhima with loud shouts discharging a shower of arrows on all sides.

verses.sanskrit: तान्स पञ्चशतान्वीरान्सपताकध्वजायुधान् । पोथयामास गदया भीमो विष्णुरिवासुरान् ॥५४॥
verses.english: Like Vishnu killing the demons Bhima, with his mace, destroyed those valiant warriors with their drivers, cars, banners, standards and weapons.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शकुनिनिर्दिष्टाः सादिनः शूरसंमताः । त्रिसाहस्राभ्ययुर्भीमं शक्त्यृष्टिप्रासपाणयः ॥५५॥
verses.english: Then three thousand cavalry led by Shakuni, held in esteem by all brave men and armed with darts, swords and lances, dashed on the great Bhima.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्युद्गम्य जवेनाशु साश्वारोहांस्तदाऽरिहा । विविधान्विचरन्मार्गान् गदया समपोथयत् ॥५६॥
verses.english: Advancing impetuously towards them and coursing in various ways that slayer of foes killed them with his mace.

verses.sanskrit: तेषामासीन्महाञ्छब्दस्ताडितानां च सर्वशः । अश्मभिर्विध्यमानानां नगानामिव भारत ॥५७॥
verses.english: While they were thus being assailed by Bhima loud sounds arose among them like those from among a herd of elephants struck with a large piece of rock.

verses.sanskrit: एवं सुबलपुत्रस्य त्रिसाहस्रान् हयोत्तमान् । हत्वाऽन्यं रथमास्थाय क्रुद्धो राधेयमभ्ययात् ॥५८॥
verses.english: Having killed those three thousand excellent horses of Subala's son in that way he rode upon another car and worked up with anger proceeded against the son of Radha.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णोऽपि समरे राजन् धर्मपुत्रमरिन्दमम् । स शरैश्छाद‌यामास सारथिं चाप्यपातयत् ॥५९॥
verses.english: Karna too, O king, coveredwith arrows in battle Dharma's son, the subduer of foes and struck down his charioteer.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स प्रद्रुतः संख्ये रथं दृष्ट्वा महारथः । अन्वधावत्किरन्बाणैः कङ्कपत्रैराजह्मगैः ॥६०॥
verses.english: Beholding him thus fly away quickly in battle the mighty car-warrior Karna pursued him shooting straight Kanka-feathered arrows.

verses.sanskrit: राजानमभिधावन्तं शरैरावृत्य रोदसी । क्रुद्धः प्रच्छाद‌यामास शरजालेन मारुतिः॥६१॥
verses.english: Covering the earth and sky with arrows, the son of the Wind-god (Bhima) covered him with a shower of arrows while he pursued the king.

verses.sanskrit: सन्निवृत्तस्ततस्तूर्णं राधेयः शत्रुकर्शनः । भीमं प्रच्छाद‌यामास समन्तान्निशितैः शरैः ॥६२॥
verses.english: Then quickly returning, the son of Radha, the subduer of enemies, covered Bhima on all sides with sharpened arrows.

verses.sanskrit: भीमसेनरथव्यग्रं कर्णं भारत सात्यकिः । अभ्यर्दयदमेयात्मा पार्ष्णिग्रहणकारणात् ॥६३॥
verses.english: Then placing himself on the side of Bhima's car, O Bharata, the highly energetic Satyaki began to afflict Karna who was in front of Bhima.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यवर्तत कर्णस्तमर्दितोऽपि शरैर्भृशम् । तावन्योन्यं समासाद्य वृषभौ सर्वधन्विनाम् ॥६४॥
verses.english: Though greatly assailed by Satyaki Karna still approached Bhima; approaching each : other, those two best of archers, the two highly energetic heroes, appeared highly resplendent as they discharged arrows at each other.

verses.sanskrit: विसृजन्तौ शरान्दीप्तान् विभ्राजेतां मनस्विनौ । ताभ्यां वियति राजेन्द्र विततं भीमदर्शनम् ॥६५॥
क्रौञ्चपृष्ठारुणं रौद्रं बाणजालं व्यदृश्यत । नैव सूर्यप्रभा राजन्न दिशः प्रदिशस्तथा ॥६६॥
verses.english: Spread by them, O king, in the sky those rows, shining as the backs of crane, looked exceedingly fierce and terrible.

verses.sanskrit: प्राज्ञासिष्म वयं ते वा शरैर्मुक्तैः सहस्रशः । मध्याह्ने तपतो राजन् भास्करस्य महाप्रभाः ॥६७॥
verses.english: On account of those thousands of arrows, O king, neither the rays of the sun nor the cardinal quarters could be seen either by ourselves or by the enemy.

verses.sanskrit: हृताः सर्वाः शरौघैस्तैः कर्णपाण्डवयोस्तदा । सौबलं कृतवर्माणं द्रौणिमाधिरथिं कृपम् ॥६८॥
verses.english: The fierceness of the sun's rays burring at midday was removed by those thick showers of arrows discharged by Karna and the son of Pandu.

verses.sanskrit: संसक्तान्पाण्डवैर्दृष्ट्वा निवृत्ताः कुरवः पुनः । तेषामापततां शब्दस्तीव्र आसीद्विशांपते ॥६९॥
verses.english: Beholding the son of Subala, Kritavarma, Drona's son, Adhiratha's son and Kripa fight with the Pandavas the Kauravas rallied and came back to the battle.

verses.sanskrit: उद्वृत्तानां यथा वृष्ट्या सागराणां भयावहः। ते सेने भृशसंसक्ते दृष्ट्वाऽन्योन्यं महाहवे ॥७०॥
verses.english: O king, the army, dashing impetuously against the enemies, caused a tumult resembling the terrible noise made by many oceans swollen with rams.

verses.sanskrit: हर्षेण महता युक्ते परिगृह्य परस्परम् । ततः प्रववृते युद्धं मध्यं प्राप्ते दिवाकरे ॥७१॥
verses.english: Furiously engaged in fight the two armies became filled with delight as the warriors saw and seized one another.

verses.sanskrit: तादृशं न कदाचिद्धि दृष्टपूर्वं न च श्रुतम् । बलौघस्तु समासाद्य बलौघं सहसा रणे ॥७२॥
verses.english: When the sun was at its meridian they engaged in fight the like of which was never seen or heard of before.

verses.sanskrit: उपासर्पत वेगेन वार्योघ इव सागरम् । आसीन्निनादः सुमहान्बाणौघानां परस्परम् ॥७३॥
verses.english: One powerful division, meeting with another such, rushed upon it with impetuosity like a huge collection of water rushing towards the ocean. The din, caused by the two armies as they roared at each other, was loud and deep like that which is heard when several oceans mingle with one another.

verses.sanskrit: गर्जतां सागरौघाणां यथा स्यान्निःस्वनो महान् । ते तु सेने समासाद्य वेगवत्यौ परस्परम् ॥७४॥
एकीभावमनुप्राप्ते नद्याविव समागमे । ततः प्रववृते युद्धं घोररूपं विशांपते ॥७५॥
verses.english: That the two furious armies, approaching one another, formed one mass like two furious rivers that run into each other.

verses.sanskrit: कुरूणां पाण्डवानां च लिप्सतां सुमहद्यशः । शूराणां गर्जतां तत्र ह्यविच्छेदकृता गिरः ॥७६॥
verses.english: Then a dreadful encounter took place between the Kurus and Pandavas who were actuated by the desire of gaining glory.

verses.sanskrit: श्रूयन्ते विविधा राजन्नामान्युद्दिश्य भारत । यस्य यद्धि रणे व्यङ्गं पितृतो मातृतोऽपि वा ॥७७॥
verses.english: O descendant of Bharata, as those warriors called one another by name a regular confusion of voices was heard.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मतः शीलतो वाऽपि स तच्छ्रावयते युधि । तान्दृष्ट्वा समरे शूरांस्तर्जमानान्परस्परम् ॥७८॥
verses.english: In that battle, his antagonist was made to hear by a hero whatever matter or ridicule he had of his father, mother, conduct of character.

verses.sanskrit: अभवन्मे मती राजन्नैषामस्तीति जीवितम् । तेषां दृष्ट्वा तु क्रुद्धानां वपूंष्यमिततेजसाम् ॥७९॥
verses.english: Beholding those heroes reviling one another in battle, O king, I thought that the lease of their life had run out.

verses.sanskrit: अभवन्मे भयं तीव्रं कथमेतद्भविष्यति । ततस्ते पाण्डवा राजन्कौरवाश्च महारथाः । ततक्षुः सायकैस्तीक्ष्णैर्निघ्नन्तो हि परस्परम् ॥८०॥
verses.english: O king! Soon thereafter the great chariot riders in Pandava and Kauravas' army started causing injuries to each other by shooting acute arrows. O king! Soon thereafter the great chariot riders in Pandava and Kauravas' army started causing injuries to each other by shooting acute arrows.
